about: Openly licensed aircraft recordings on Freesound, for testing. Facts are only what each author published on the sound's page (checked 2026-11-20). Attribution is required for CC BY works.

examples.title: Small plane flyover 2
examples.author: SoundsLikeYukon
examples.recorded: an August evening at around 10 p.m. (uploaded 2025-08-19); exact date not published
examples.aircraft: small plane, most likely a Cessna
examples.tests: Detection on a real prop flyover. Location test only if the exact date is known; Yukon is outside the continental-US dataset (needs world data).

examples.title: Airplane-fly-over-1
examples.author: charlieshread
examples.place: a residential home near an airport (place not published)
examples.tests: Detection only (no location or time published).

examples.title: Aircraft Flyover (Likely Helicopter) with Rural Ambience
examples.author: TSP-Talk
examples.aircraft: low aircraft, most likely a helicopter
examples.tests: Detection on a long rural recording. Helicopters have rotor tones that differ from propeller planes. No location test (time not published, Germany needs world data).

examples.title: Heavy Aircraft Pass-By
examples.author: TSP-Talk
examples.tests: Detection of a large (likely turboprop or jet) aircraft. No location test (time not published).

examples.title: F22 Fighter Jet Flyover
examples.author: marcushagued
examples.attribution: "F22 Fighter Jet Flyover" by marcushagued (freesound.org), CC BY 4.0
examples.tests: Jet-band detection on a loud, fast military jet. Military jets often do not broadcast public ADS-B, so no location test.

examples.title: DoKomi Airplane 04
examples.author: TruliVerse
examples.place: near the DoKomi 2026 convention grounds, Düsseldorf, Germany
examples.tests: Detection near a busy airport (Düsseldorf). Short clip: the closest moment must be inside it.

examples.title: Propeller Plane
examples.author: clif_creates
examples.place: on the grass behind the LAX landing strip, Los Angeles, California
examples.tests: Detection of a close prop pass. No location test: it predates the adsb.lol archive (2023 onward).

examples.title: park village Dorst NL 0331 PM 170328_1114
examples.author: klankbeeld
examples.attribution: "park village Dorst NL" by klankbeeld (freesound.org), CC BY 4.0. The author asks for credit and does not allow use in royalty-free stock collections.
examples.place: park/forest near Dorst, North Brabant, Netherlands
examples.tests: Detection with birdsong and wind (a hard real-world case). Published place and time, but 2017 predates the adsb.lol archive, so no location test.
